gatoh.visualisation.visualisation.ABVisualiser

class ABVisualiser(model: Any, visualisation_dir: str, aggregation_method: str = 'median', save_visualisations: bool = True)[source]
The visualisations will include:

  • Graph structure plotting

  • Realtime model runtime display

  • Post-runtime summarisation graphs

  • Per-agent lifetime information

  • Per-graph lifetime information

Parameters:

  • model (gatoh.model.model.ABModel) – The model that this visualiser is being attached to.

  • visualisation_dir (str) – A path to a subdirectory to which all relevant visualisation outputs should be saved to.

  • aggregation_method (str, optional) – The method to use for aggregating parameters (i.e. ``mean’’, ``median’’, etc.).

  • save_visualisations (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the visualisation outputs should be saved.
